The '''Quians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Quian|same name]]. They had extremely dark skin, light brown hair, and aqua-green eyes. [[Benald Orlan|Benald]], his [[Benald Orlan's father|father]], and his mother [[Karin Orlan]] were Quians.
